name: lc1
purpose: First generated long-channel planar NMOS candidate for a resistively loaded common-source stage. Starting hypothesis, not a qualified design.

contacts.gate: ohmic contact on top of the n+ polysilicon gate region (sets the gate work function to n+ poly)
contacts.source: top silicon surface from the left edge to the left gate edge
contacts.drain: top silicon surface from the right gate edge to the right edge

physics: DEVSIM simple_physics: constant mobility (mu_n 400, mu_p 200 cm^2/Vs), SRH, drift-diffusion, no velocity saturation, no field-dependent mobility, no gate tunneling, no interface charge
